checks.name: profile_load
checks.details: measured_tcad_profile_v1 loaded and schema validation passed.

checks.name: profile_calibration_status
checks.details: Profile is marked reference/proxy, so it must not be used as a product accuracy LUT.

evidence.note: Public-reference anchored defaults for practical exploration only.

checks.name: reference_mode
checks.details: reference_mode=true keeps public anchors and stable defaults for exploration only.

checks.name: implant_sources_measured
checks.details: One or more implant profiles are unmeasured reference/analytic profiles.

checks.name: transfer_gate_proxy_present
checks.details: Transfer-gate barrier feature is present in the profile.

checks.name: floating_diffusion_proxy_present
checks.details: Floating-diffusion doping feature is present in the profile.

checks.name: dti_geometry_present
checks.details: DTI/liner geometry proxy is present.

checks.name: bdti_geometry_present
checks.details: BDTI geometry is present.

checks.name: fixed_charge_applied
checks.details: At least one fixed/effective interface charge term is executable.

checks.name: interface_trap_density_declared
checks.details: Interface trap density is supplied; solver implementation is checked from DEVSIM summaries.

checks.name: mobility_recombination_calibrated
checks.details: Doping-dependent transport is configured, but it is still reference/unmeasured and lacks target-sensor calibration.

checks.name: split_devsim_profile_model
checks.details: All split-PD summaries used electrical_model=profile-ppd.

checks.name: optical_generation_map_imported
checks.details: All split-PD summaries used imported Meep G(x,depth).

checks.name: transport_models_applied
checks.details: DEVSIM split summaries used doping-dependent mobility/lifetime models in the solver path.

checks.name: field_dependent_mobility_applied
checks.details: DEVSIM split summaries include field-dependent effective edge mobility for velocity saturation.

checks.name: terminal_current_balance
checks.details: Illuminated terminal-current balance is within 1e-09 A/cm.

checks.name: profile_features_applied_to_netdoping
checks.details: Executable TG, FD, BDTI, and fixed-charge feature masks are present; nonzero-effect counts show runtime-disabled roles such as FD scale=0 for PD-only response sweeps.

checks.name: interface_trap_occupancy_equations
checks.details: DEVSIM summaries include potential-dependent interface-trap charge and SRH sheet recombination proxies.

checks.name: metadata_only_electrical_terms
checks.details: No metadata-only electrical terms were reported by the supplied split summaries.

checks.name: gmsh_contacts_imported
checks.details: Gmsh import summaries contain silicon and all three contacts.

checks.name: gmsh_dimensions_smoked
checks.details: Both 2D and 3D Gmsh import smoke solves were supplied.

checks.name: resolved_dti_oxide_solver_path
checks.details: Resolved side DTI/BDTI oxide regions and Si/oxide interface were exported to Gmsh and solved by DEVSIM.

checks.name: fdtd_convergence_report
checks.details: FDTD grid/convergence report is partial; full resolution, time, and PML coverage has not all passed for accuracy use.

checks.name: fdtd_crosstalk_xsection_convergence
checks.details: High-resolution 2D FDTD crosstalk x-section convergence passed for configured split/OCL cases.

checks.name: native_devsim_response_convergence
checks.details: Native DEVSIM direct response passed mesh-refinement convergence.

checks.name: signed_field_symmetry_validation
checks.details: Signed field LUT was validated against direct negative-CRA FDTD/native-DEVSIM anchors.

checks.name: camera_lut_spectral_coverage
checks.details: Camera-system field LUT covers the required RGB wavelength anchors on a uniform signed field grid.

checks.name: camera_system_field_lut_direct_z_diag_coverage
checks.details: Dense field LUT uses direct RGB x-axis, z-axis, and diagonal native-DEVSIM anchors without radial fallback.

checks.name: tg_fd_terminal_diagnostic
checks.details: TG/FD diagnostic has a real floating-diffusion terminal, finite FD response rows, and terminal balance closure.

checks.name: tg_fd_transient_diagnostic
checks.details: TG/FD diagnostic uses paired photo-minus-dark DEVSIM transient time stepping and reports carrier inventory.

checks.name: tg_fd_transfer_inventory_effect
checks.details: Carrier inventory shows photo-generated electrons leaving the PD region and FD terminal integration collects positive electron charge.

evidence.fd_inventory_gain_note: A voltage-clamped FD ohmic terminal can collect electrons while the local FD silicon inventory decreases; FD volume gain is evidence only, not the pass criterion.

checks.name: tg_fd_transfer_settling
checks.details: FD terminal photo-minus-dark current decays below 10% of its peak by the end of the transfer pulse.

checks.name: calibration_result
checks.details: Calibration optimizer reported success.

checks.name: calibration_targets_measured
checks.details: Calibration targets are missing target_source=measured or are explicitly synthetic.

checks.name: calibration_target_residuals
checks.details: Best calibration entry passes per-target current and split residual tolerances.

checks.name: transport_runtime_calibration_controls
checks.details: Runtime mobility, lifetime, fixed-charge, and interface-trap calibration controls are wired into DEVSIM summaries.

checks.name: transport_multi_parameter_calibration
checks.details: Multi-parameter calibration report passes current/split and metric residual checks.

checks.name: measured_optical_stack_nk
checks.details: Optical stack evidence exists, but geometry and/or material n,k are not marked measured.

calibration_status.note: Geometry and material n,k are public-reference/proxy values for framework development only.

checks.name: devsim_weighting_laplace_summary
checks.details: DEVSIM-native pure-Laplace terminal weighting summary is internally consistent.

checks.name: devsim_weighting_csv
checks.details: DEVSIM weighting CSV row count and required columns are valid.

checks.name: devsim_weighting_mesh_matches_split_runs
checks.details: DEVSIM weighting node count does not match one or more split-PD runs, but the supplied primary response manifest is native_devsim-only; the weighting surrogate mesh is not used by this direct terminal-current LUT.

checks.name: native_devsim_direct_method_present
checks.details: Camera diagnostic includes native_devsim direct FDTD-generation DEVSIM responses.

checks.name: native_devsim_direct_cases_present
checks.details: Every camera-system case has finite native DEVSIM terminal-current response and split phase.

checks.name: camera_system_research_lut_native_export
checks.details: Camera-system research LUT is exported from native_devsim direct responses.

checks.name: camera_system_research_lut_numerical_convergence
checks.details: Research LUT embeds a passing optical numerical-convergence report.

checks.name: camera_system_research_lut_full_numerical_coverage
checks.details: Research LUT optical convergence is partial; one or more of resolution, time, or PML axes were not varied.

checks.name: camera_system_research_lut_optical_grid_evidence
checks.details: Research LUT includes per-case FDTD optical grid evidence and every case passes the configured grid-resolution gate.

checks.name: gw_manifest_weighting_methods
checks.details: Native-only research LUT manifest supplied; G*W surrogate weighting is not part of this direct terminal-current export.

checks.name: gw_devsim_dd_probe_method_present
checks.details: Native-only research LUT uses direct DEVSIM terminal-current deltas; sparse DD-probe surrogate is optional and not required for this export.
